hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: We want to identify claims in the top 5th percentile of fraud score within each state.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Use the percent_rank() window function partitioned by state and ordered by fraud_score descending.

hints.title: Query Construction
hints.text: Filter for percent_rank <= 0.05 and order results by state ascending, fraud_score descending, and policy_id ascending.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RankedFraud AS (
    SELECT 
        policy_id, 
        state, 
        fraud_score,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY state 
            ORDER BY fraud_score DESC
        ) AS p_rank
    FROM Fraud
)
SELECT 
    policy_id, 
    state, 
    fraud_score
FROM RankedFraud
WHERE p_rank <= 0.05
ORDER BY 
    state ASC, 
    fraud_score DESC, 
    policy_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Partitioned percent rank window calculation followed by threshold filter.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Calculating percentile cutoffs per state manually requires multiple passes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use percent_rank window function partitioned by state to isolate top percentiles cleanly.
